meera: FYI saw a TTFT spike on /api/generate in the canary this morning. decode time per token looks normal but overall TTFT is +120ms vs prod :thinking:
jiwon: can you paste a sample trace or pprof? any kernel switch logs?
meera: here's an excerpt from the trace (sanitized):\n\n```
TRACE: req=0x7f.. kernel_pick=23ms prequeue_wait=35ms kernel_init=78ms decode=6ms kvcache_lookup=12ms
STACK: kernel_selector -> microbatcher -> dispatch -> kernel_init
```
\nmeera: note kernel_init is the big bit, not decode. also kvcache miss ratio up ~12% on that route.
alex: that pattern smells like microbatches getting sized ~1-2 tokens then kernel warmup dominates. batching heuristic may be favouring latency for small seqs and inadvertently increasing kernel churn.

sam: can you dump the batching window histogram for that route? we might be splitting requests because of the route-level priority config.
meera: dumping histogram now, trimmed: `counts: {1: 410, 2: 95, 8+: 12}` — lots of single-token microbatches.
jiwon: oof. kernel selection overhead per kernel_init is ~70-90ms on this GPU build (new cudnn kernels). if batching bundles more requests we amortize that. idea: add a dynamic grouping threshold that relaxes prequeue timeout when estimated kernel_init > X ms.
alex: +1. Also add metric panels:\n- token_ttft_ms (median/p95)\n- kernel_init_ms (median/p95)\n- kernel_selector_ms (time spent choosing kernel)\n- kvcache_hit_rate per-route\n- microbatch_size_distribution (histogram buckets)
sam: and add a derived KPI: kernel_init_cost_per_token = kernel_init_ms / avg_microbatch_tokens to monitor amortization.
meera: I can sketch a dashboard PR. plan: instrument kernel_selector to emit labels for path (prequeue, selection, init) and a sampling flag so we don't blow metrics. also emit microbatch_size at request completion.
infra-bot: deploy-notice: canary cluster 3 started rolling back canary/2021-03c due to elevated TTFT alerts (alert-id: TTFT-592). :rotating_light:
jiwon: let's also pin the old kernel build on canary until we have the batching change tested. regression looks tied to the new kernel behavior.
meera: filing PR for metrics + small heuristic change: draft PR #3421, owner @meera. will add tests + synthetic load job to validate amortization before promoting.
alex: for now, add an alert: if kernel_init_ms_p95 > 60ms AND avg_microbatch_size < 2 -> fire. that'll catch this pattern early.
sam: I'll add the kvcache hit-rate heatmap per route too. we should correlate route paramization (max_new_tokens) with observed microbatch distribution.
meera: thanks — I'll post the PR and a synthetic job link when ready. next sync in #eng-runtime sync tomorrow. :eyes:
